intended_object: The coalgebra structure map (transition function) of an auxiliary cyclic proof used in the cut-based left interpolation construction for GL; inferred from the docstring and its use in `partialInterpolationLeft`.
explanation: The definition builds the structure map α on the carrier Unit ⊕ (partialEquationLeft x).X ⊕ 𝕐₂.X. The root node applies a cut on the interpolant and points to the roots of the two subproofs. The other nodes keep the rules and children of `partialEquationLeft x` or of 𝕐₂ (the latter converted by `splitToExt`). It is a gluing step inside the proof of interpolation and only supplies data for `partialInterpolationLeft`. The companion lemma `partialInterpolationLeftPath` shows it is definitionally an instance of `combinedInterpolationAlpha`. It does not correspond to a standard mathematical notion, so it is an internal technical device and Mathlib has no counterpart.
